_comment: Thresholds for the /light/ no-flicker gates (tests/browser/light.mjs). A bound may only tighten: the test refuses any value looser than the ceiling in the plan (KTD6). Medians are measured under SwiftShader; each bound records why.

medians.scope: SwiftShader, Chromium 1248 arm64, first calibration run, 3 s scripted drift

reasons.p95DrawIntervalMs: Measured p95 is 40.3 ms at worst (synthetic 120 Hz timer jitter); 45 ms leaves runner noise headroom and is tighter than the 50 ms ceiling.
reasons.fractionDrawIntervalsOver50ms: Measured 0 on every run; 0.02 tolerates a single scheduler hiccup in a 90-draw window.
reasons.maxDrawsPerSecond: Kept at the ceiling: the time gate yields 30 draws a second; a sliding 1 s window counts 31 points at most.
reasons.others: Kept at the plan ceilings; measured values are all at the best possible value (0).
